titulo: Repeating a word for emphasis (café café, quererlo lo quiero)
subtitulo: Cenar cenar, no. Quererlo lo quiero, pero...
regla: In conversation, repeating a word stresses its real or full sense: No es café café (not real coffee). Infinitive + same verb conjugated + pero... = I do..., but...: Quererlo lo quiero, pero es muy celoso.

lista.texto: _really, properly, the real thing_: **cenar cenar, no**; **negativa negativa no fue**.

bloques.texto: Very colloquial. In Mexico you'll hear things like **café café** (real coffee, not instant) or **¿pero novio novio?** (_an actual boyfriend?_).
Tip: saying it twice turns up the volume.

lista.es: La verdad, ==negativa negativa== no fue la sorpresa; no me importaba si era niño o niña.
lista.en: Honestly, the surprise wasn't really negative; I didn't care if it was a boy or a girl.

lista.es: Bueno, yo ==cenar cenar== no quiero. Mejor unos tacos y una cerveza.
lista.en: Well, I don't want a proper dinner. Just some tacos and a beer.

lista.es: A Pablo ==quererlo lo quiero==, pero es tan celoso que a veces pienso en dejarlo.
lista.en: I do love Pablo, but he's so jealous I sometimes think of leaving him.
But is he your actual boyfriend?
I do know, but I can't remember.

lista.nota: Pronoun on both is more common.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Emphatic: _It's not really a party; just a few friends._
lista.r: Fiesta fiesta no es; solo unos amigos.

lista.p: Emphatic: _I do like it, but it's expensive._
lista.r: Gustarme me gusta, pero es caro.
